consolidated_group means group-wide scope; plain 公司 in report-wide operating text defaults to it unless local evidence gives a narrower object. issuer means an explicitly parent-only company, not merely the reporting company. named_subsidiary means a specified subsidiary; business_segment means the specified business, product or industry row. unclear preserves scope that cannot be established.
Judge each metric's own source object independently of its enclosing fact. A business or industry row does not inherit consolidated_group from a company-wide fact or a consolidated table. Keep the source category in the metric name. Apply these meanings to original and repaired facts alike; never change a label just to pass review. A locatable amount, similar amounts or an arithmetic sum alone cannot establish subject scope or equivalence between source categories.
An operating/management actor, a metric's statistical slice and asset ownership are different relationships. Entrusted management does not establish ownership. Geography or sales mode alone does not establish a business segment. Preserve the source's actual relationships in the narrative; when one enum cannot faithfully express them, use unclear with a specific reason. Unclear/unknown cannot excuse known wrong narrative, period or citations. Metrics keep their own source scope.
Independently check the fact's own subject_scope and period against the ORIGINAL source,
as well as its text and qualifications, even when metrics[] is empty or withheld.
Then check each metric's own scope and period separately. Correct metric metadata or
withholding a metric cannot cure an incorrect fact.subject_scope or fact.period.
Read the local heading, actor, classification axis and time/condition before choosing
a scope. Geography, customer classifications and sales modes do not by themselves
establish business_segment; distinguish them from an explicit business/product/industry
row. A consolidated table does not make a narrower business fact group-wide, and a
main-business total is not automatically one business segment. Apply the existing
report-wide 公司 default only without a narrower or conflicting local source object.
If the available scope labels cannot faithfully express the supplied source, preserve
the source wording with subject_scope=unclear and a specific uncertainty_reason;
do not force a business_segment or group label or change the source meaning.
Check fact.period independently of the report year and of every metric.period.
Signing, completion conditions, post-transaction ownership and future plans are distinct
from realized report-period results. Preserve the stated event time and condition in
both the assertion and its period; do not invent a completion date. The report year
alone does not establish that a proposed or conditional outcome has already occurred.
Faithful sourced uncertainty may remain limited without extra reading or repair.
An uncertainty_reason must explain what is unresolved and retain the source wording;
it cannot excuse a known false assertion, wrong definite scope or unsupported citation.

Check every proposed repaired fact against the ORIGINAL source packet
and initial findings. Return Chinese JSON checked_fact_ids and one check for every
candidate ID. accepted=true only if that candidate substantively resolves the issue
with the correct subject, period, financial column, units, denominator and evidence.
A locatable number or same fact ID alone does not establish correctness. Preserve
original uncertainty, qualifiers and elimination/net accounting. False assertions or
unjustified certainty must be rejected with source evidence. No publication approval or new repairs.
Faithful source wording explicitly marked uncertain can resolve an overstatement without
resolving the underlying uncertainty. Do not require an exact value absent from the source.
Accept a correctly narrowed core fact even if it omits optional comparisons or details.
Reject zero-like financial absence inferred from a blank cell, a different column or
a -100% change, whether or not the candidate contains a numeric zero.
Novelty or being outside the baseline is not a rejection reason for company_features.
An applicability checkbox describes its disclosure item, not economic absence. Check the candidate's
text and structured period together; a next-year plan must not become a current result.
Explanatory style alone does not reject a fact that resolves the actual source issue.

一、报告期内公司从事的业务情况
    华贸物流作为中国领先的第三方国际综合物流服务商与国际物流优选方案提供者，具备卓越

的综合统筹服务能力。公司服务产品兼具稳定性、标准化与集约化特征，物流网络资源广泛覆盖
海内外关键节点，在行业内拥有显著的品牌影响力和核心竞争优势。

    公司主营业务包括国际空海铁综合物流服务、跨境电商物流、国际工程综合物流、国际仓储
物流、国际大宗商品合同物流、特大件特种专业物流等六大板块。
    依托强大的全球网络覆盖能力，公司构建了覆盖“门到门”的一站式国际物流生态体系，能够

高效响应客户在供应链优化与业务拓展过程中的多样化需求。近年来，公司在中国货代企业百强
榜综合实力排名中稳居前列。2025              年  8月，全球知名物流咨询机构              Armstrong& Associates发布

的全球货代     25 强榜单显示，华贸物流海运业务位列全球第                    15位，空运业务位列全球第            14 位，标
志着公司已成功跻身具有国际竞争力的全球物流企业行列。

    公司经营模式是为客户提供第三方跨境综合物流服务，服务内容涵盖运输、仓储、包装、搬
运装卸、流通、配送、干线运输、港口通关服务、单证制作、交易结算等，服务链条包括点对点、
港到港、门到门全程或者部分环节，同时还提供现代物流方案的咨询、分析、诊断、设计、优化、

控制、信息服务等其他综合服务。公司经营模式的核心是根据客户的需求，全过程协同整合跨境
物流境内集货、分拣装箱、出境通关办理、国际间干线运输，以及境外入境通关办理、拆箱分拣、

终端派送七大构成要素，收取服务费用。
 公司商业模式竞争优势是不断提高全链条特别是境外端服务能力，依靠系统化科技提高效率降

低成本促进安全，坚持客户为本营销发展理念，获取了更多直客和重要客户。公司经营模式的核
心是全过程协同整合跨境物流七大构成要素，满足客户的最佳需求。

    华贸物流作为物流国家队，一直把防范产业链供应链安全风险，提升产业链供应链韧性和安
全水平，维护经济社会稳定和国家安全产业链供应链安全作为重要工作。重要指导原则，工作中

贯彻总体国家安全观，统筹发展和安全，为推进高水平对外开放，促进全球产业链供应链稳定畅
通做贡献。

    物流作为实体经济的“筋络”，连接着生产和消费，是畅通国民经济的重要环节，推进畅通
国内国际双循环，推动物流业降本增效都是趋势，是华贸物流高质量发展的新思路。
    在经济全球化与数字经济深度融合的时代背景下，全球物流业作为连接生产与消费的核心纽

带，正经历着前所未有的变革。随着全球贸易格局的重塑、科技革命的加速推进以及环保与合规

    表现一：跨境电商的爆发式增长推动了国际物流的快速发展，物流企业纷纷构建全球物流网
络，通过海外仓、保税仓等方式缩短配送时间，提升客户体验。

    表现二：全球化扩张的同时，物流企业也越来越注重海外的本地化运营。
    表现三：信息化时代，物流行业的数据安全问题日益凸显，各国政府纷纷加强对物流企业数
据安全的监管。物流企业需要建立完善的数据安全管理体系，保护消费者隐私和商业秘密。

    表现四：未来亚太地区将成为竞争热点，拉美市场是拓展蓝海，中东和非洲市场是新布局突
破口。

    表现五：跨境电商物流在“一带一路”倡议推动下，小包件量年增速超过                                 30%，需进一步优
化海外仓布局并提升最后一公里配送效率。

    表现六：AI    技术将深度赋能物流预测，销售趋势、消费习惯等多维度数据。
    表现七：信息化引领物流新高度，精准的库存管理、降低库存积压与仓储成本、避免缺货、
按照大平台的要求及时送达等都需要信息化引领。

作为核心抓手。海外仓作为连接国内供应链与海外市场的关键枢纽，不仅显著提升跨境物流时效

与履约稳定性，更是公司构建全球化服务能力、增强供应链韧性的重要基石。在全球化经营过程
中，客户普遍面临跨境物流周期长、成本高、库存管理复杂等痛点，对海外前置仓的需求日益迫

切。海外仓的设立，能够帮助客户实现货物前置、就近发货，大幅缩短配送时效，提升终端消费

    以海外仓为战略支点，公司逐步构建起集干线运输、智能清关、仓储管理、精准配送于一体

的全链条、一站式服务体系，全方位、高效率响应客户在全球化布局中产生的多元化、定制化及
个性化物流需求。

盖欧洲、美洲、亚太、澳洲及非洲等全球核心贸易区域，形成了多区域联动、多节点协同的海外

仓储矩阵。该布局有效提升了公司在全球主要贸易区域的资源调配能力与抗风险能力，为全链条

```","initial_findings":[{"finding_id":"FR-PS-01","element":"products_services","severity":"minor","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","action":"correct","affected_fact_id":"F-PS-01","evidence_ids":["source-0001","source-0008","source-0009"],"explanation":"source-0009将国际空运、海运、铁路、跨境电商、大宗商品物流及仓储陆运表述为综合物流服务体系覆盖的领域，并未建立“综合物流与专业物流”二分。source-0008在“重点工程物流”下同时写明聚焦能源、基础设施建设，并完成哈密—重庆、衡阳换流站、金上—湖北等重大电力设备运输；原文没有把前一类活动归入“国际工程物流”、把电力设备运输单独归入“特大件特种专业物流”。source-0001只并列六大板块名称，不能完成该活动归属。空运、海运、铁路、跨境电商、大宗及仓储陆运的服务描述可保留，工程与电力设备运输应改回重点工程物流口径，或明确该名称对应关系未经原文建立。"},{"finding_id":"FR-CUST-01","element":"customers_channels_markets","severity":"minor","issue_type":"wrong_subject","action":"correct","affected_fact_id":"F-CUST-01","evidence_ids":["source-0008","source-0009"],"explanation":"国家电网、南方电网、中国电气、上海电气、特变电工、中信重工以及能源、基础设施建设聚焦，出自source-0008“重点工程物流”，该段未使用“国际工程物流”。铁路汽车客户、大宗商品合作方、仓储陆运行业和跨境电商服务方式与source-0009一致，可保留。须将前述客户从国际工程物流改回重点工程物流，不能用分产品表中的国际工程物流行自动等同该段客户。"},{"finding_id":"FR-SC-UP-01","element":"upstream_inputs","severity":"minor","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","action":"correct","affected_fact_id":"F-SC-UP-01","evidence_ids":["source-0006","source-0008","source-0009"],"explanation":"source-0009将自有定班航线、自有集装箱船公司卓跃船务（BSL）及独立承运人代码表述为公司自有运力；source-0006、source-0008将海外网点和海外仓表述为自有或自控运营。全球主流船东核心合约、COC包舱协议以及与中铁联集、中铁多联的合作才是外部运力合作。原文没有把自有资产称为上游资源。应分开保留自有资源与外部合作，不能写成“上游资源包括自有定班航线、自有船公司、海外仓和自有网点”。"},{"finding_id":"FR-SCALE-OMIT-01","element":"scale_and_mix","severity":"material","issue_type":"material_omission","action":"possible_omission","affected_fact_id":null,"evidence_ids":["source-0011"],"explanation":"source-0011同一经营结果句写明2025年营业收入同比增长2.51%，但归属母公司净利润4.88亿元同比减少9.37%，扣除非经常性损益后归属母公司净利润3.76亿元同比减少18.91%，每股收益0.37元同比减少9.76%。现有底稿只保留收入增幅和两项利润金额，未保留利润与每股收益的下降方向，会改变对当期盈利结果的理解。建议按原文单独补记上述同比减少，不与分产品收入构成混为同一修复目标。"}],"candidates":[{"fact_id":"F-PS-01","text":"在具体工作方面，公司开展重点工程物流和综合物流服务。重点工程物流聚焦能源、基础设施建设等核心领域重大项目物流需求，全年完成多项国家级重点工程物流保障任务并完成重大电力设备运输161台；综合物流服务覆盖国际空运、国际海运、国际铁路、跨境电商、大宗商品物流及仓储陆运等核心领域。国际空运通过境外子公司运力投入和自有定班航线开展；国际海运成立自有集装箱船公司卓跃船务（BSL）并取得独立承运人代码（BHL）；国际铁路与中铁联集、中铁多联合作联合开行国际班列，并以服务国产汽车出海为标杆；跨境电商开展海外大城市国际专线速递、中亚中俄中欧电商TIR卡车、海外仓一件代发及电商退换货回程服务；大宗商品物流提供粮食、铁矿石、煤炭等专业化、一体化物流服务；仓储陆运对接汽车、电商、快消、大宗商品、工业制造等行业，提供仓储管理、陆运配送、装卸搬运等服务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008","source-0009"],"metrics":[],"uncertainty_reason":null},{"fact_id":"F-CUST-01","text":"客户与渠道覆盖：重点工程物流聚焦能源、基础设施建设，服务国家电网、南方电网、中国电气、上海电气、特变电工、中信重工等；国际铁路以国产汽车出海为标杆，与长安、广汽、理想等汽车客户合作；大宗商品物流与建发、物产中大、紫金矿业、厦门钨业等合作；仓储陆运对接汽车、电商、快消、大宗商品、工业制造等行业；跨境电商开拓海外大城市国际专线速递、中亚中俄中欧电商TIR卡车、海外仓一件代发及电商退换货回程服务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008","source-0009"],"metrics":[],"uncertainty_reason":null},{"fact_id":"F-SC-UP-01","text":"公司跨境运力与网络节点包括：2025年开通并稳定运营6条自有定班航线；成立自有集装箱船公司卓跃船务（BSL），取得独立承运人代码（BHL）；自控运营海外仓并拥有自有海外网点。外部合作方面，公司与全球主流船东保持60张核心全球合约并签署4条航线长期COC包舱协议，与中铁联集、中铁多联建立战略合作关系并联合开行国际班列。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0006","source-0008","source-0009"],"metrics":[],"uncertainty_reason":null},{"fact_id":"review-add:FR-SCALE-OMIT-01","text":"2025年公司实现营业收入179.64亿元，同比增长2.51%；实现归属母公司净利润4.88亿元，同比减少9.37%；扣除非经常性损益后归属母公司净利润3.76亿元，同比减少18.91%；每股收益0.37元，同比减少9.76%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0011"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"179.64亿元","value":"179.64","unit":"亿元","source_unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","comparison_basis":"同比增长2.51%","qualifier":"exact","uncertainty_reason":null},{"name":"归属母公司净利润","raw_value":"4.88亿元","value":"4.88","unit":"亿元","source_unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","comparison_basis":"同比减少9.37%","qualifier":"exact","uncertainty_reason":null},{"name":"扣除非经常性损益后归属母公司净利润","raw_value":"3.76亿元","value":"3.76","unit":"亿元","source_unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","comparison_basis":"同比减少18.91%","qualifier":"exact","uncertainty_reason":null},{"name":"每股收益","raw_value":"0.37元","value":"0.37","unit":"元","source_unit":"元","currency":"人民币","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","comparison_basis":"同比减少9.76%","qualifier":"exact","uncertainty_reason":null}],"uncertainty_reason":null}]}

message.content: {"checked_fact_ids":["F-PS-01","F-CUST-01","F-SC-UP-01","review-add:FR-SCALE-OMIT-01"],"checks":[{"fact_id":"F-PS-01","accepted":true,"evidence_ids":["source-0008","source-0009"],"explanation":"source-0008、source-0009将能源与基础设施建设重大项目及2025年累计161台重大电力设备运输写在“重点工程物流”下，并将国际空运、海运、铁路、跨境电商、大宗商品物流及仓储陆运写为“综合物流服务”覆盖领域。修复稿已改回该口径，未把工程或电力设备运输归入国际工程物流或特大件特种专业物流，也未建立“综合物流与专业物流”二分。主体为报告经营正文中的公司，合并口径正确；161台对应2025年，期间与原文一致，省略32台专列等可选细节不影响核心修复。"},{"fact_id":"F-CUST-01","accepted":true,"evidence_ids":["source-0008","source-0009"],"explanation":"国家电网、南方电网、中国电气、上海电气、特变电工、中信重工及能源、基础设施聚焦出自source-0008“重点工程物流”，该段未使用“国际工程物流”。source-0009的长安、广汽、理想，建发、物产中大、紫金矿业、厦门钨业，仓储陆运行业及跨境电商服务方式均与修复稿一致。已将前述客户改回重点工程物流，未用分产品表的国际工程物流行等同该段客户；公司主体与2025年度期间符合报告期经营表述。"},{"fact_id":"F-SC-UP-01","accepted":true,"evidence_ids":["source-0006","source-0008","source-0009"],"explanation":"source-0009将2025年开通并稳定运营的6条自有定班航线、卓跃船务（BSL）及独立承运人代码（BHL）表述为公司自有运力，并将60张核心全球合约、4条航线长期COC包舱协议和中铁联集、中铁多联合作表述为外部合作。source-0006支持截至2025年末的自有海外网点，source-0008支持自控运营海外仓。修复稿分开保留自有资源与外部合作，未再称为上游资源；数量、名称、主体及2025年度期间与原文一致。"},{"fact_id":"review-add:FR-SCALE-OMIT-01","accepted":true,"evidence_ids":["source-0011"],"explanation":"source-0011同一经营结果句写明2025年营业收入179.64亿元、同比增长2.51%，归属母公司净利润4.88亿元同比减少9.37%，扣除非经常性损益后归属母公司净利润3.76亿元同比减少18.91%，每股收益0.37元同比减少9.76%。修复稿单独保留下降方向、扣非口径、单位和同比基数，未与分产品收入构成混同。营业收入与同页合并利润表本期数17,964,066,948.74元相符，四项指标均为公司合并经营结果，主体与2025年度期间正确。"}]}
